title: Model browsing follows the live catalog
summary:
Model pages, activity, and key settings now draw from the live catalog; the app showcase shed four dead links.

Enter’s model tables and Pollen examples now load the live model catalog for names, descriptions, capabilities, categories, badges, and price sorting. The public site and model monitor also use live model endpoints instead of bundled registry data.

Activity labels and modality breakdowns now use catalog metadata, including video, embedding, and realtime models. Key-permission choices and authorization chips use catalog categories, while model-list API responses include category and display metadata.

Four unavailable community apps were removed from the catalog after repeated link checks, so the showcase no longer sends readers to those dead pages.

daily.title: Models from the live catalog
daily.text: Browse models in Enter with catalog-backed capabilities, categories, badges, and price sorting. Activity now accounts for video, embedding, and realtime models too. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Richer model list responses
daily.text: Model list API responses now include category and display metadata, so apps can show model details without keeping a separate registry. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
